summary: Build ethical hacking and penetration-testing skills with PECB training, virtual labs, and preparation for the Lead Ethical Hacker exam.
audienceIntro: This five-day course is intended for professionals who work with information security or need to plan, manage, or perform penetration tests. Prior information-security knowledge and advanced operating-system skills are the stated main prerequisites. Information security officers responsible for information-system security. Cybersecurity professionals conducting or overseeing penetration testing. Information security team members strengthening ethical-hacking capability. Managers of ethical-hacking activities and penetration-testing engagements. Expert advisors guiding ethical-hacking activities and test planning. Technical experts planning and performing information-system penetration tests.
prerequisites: The main requirement is knowledge of information security concepts and principles and advanced skills in operating systems. Knowledge of computer networks and programming concepts is recommended. To apply for the PECB Certified Lead Ethical Hacker credential under the brochure’s pathway, you need two years of penetration-testing and cybersecurity experience and must sign the PECB Code of Ethics and PECB CLEH Code of Conduct. Consult PECB’s current certification rules to confirm your applicable pathway.
